page.overview:
What is Gurdurr?

Gurdurr is a gray hourglass-shaped humanoid with a large, round violet nose. It has hair-like protrusions on its head. Prominent swelling pink veins surround its limbs and chest, as well as its shoulders. Gurdurr always carries an "I Beam Girder" in its arms.

Gurdurr uses its steel girder to train its muscles, which it shows off to its comrades, though if it fails to impress them, it keeps a low profile. It also prefers to destroy rather than build; it is said to excel at demolition and be terrible at construction. Groups of Gurdurr and Machoke can sometimes be seen comparing their muscles with each other; "losers" will drop out of future comparisons in favor of additional training.

Gurdurr is very sturdy, so sturdy that even a group of wrestlers cannot make it budge.

Gurdurr evolves from Timburr starting at level 25 and evolves into Conkeldurr if traded.
